one_liner: LiveAgent helpdesk has a documented REST API v3 that uses admin-generated API keys. Testing works on a 30-day no-card trial, and long-term use needs a paid plan. The vendor's MCP server needs the Business plan or higher.
auth_notes: An admin generates an API key under Configuration > System > API, and the docs UI then authorizes with that key and scopes. The pages show no OAuth flow for the REST API. Keys belong to one account (domain), so each customer needs its own key.
access_notes: The 30-day free trial needs no credit card, and the API docs recommend a trial account for testing. The draft cited a "LiveAgent Free plan" FAQ line, but that page isn't in the supplied text, so I dropped it. Whether a free plan exists or includes API access is unresolved. The Enterprise page also says API keys have no plan limits there, which implies limits on lower plans.
blocker_notes: REST API testing works on a 30-day trial, and long-term use likely needs a paid plan. The MCP server needs Business or higher, and the draft's "Enterprise only" claim was wrong. Setup is per customer, with its own domain and API key.

evidence.quote: While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API
Consider registering a new [free Trial account](https://www.liveagent.com/trial/) for testing purposes, before using API with your live account.
Choose the object (agents, tickets, .) & method (get, post, delete) and press the "Try it out" button
Connecting outside AI tools this way needs the Business plan or higher.
The MCP server, so you can connect LiveAgent to external AI tools such as Claude.
